description:
Life expectancy in New Zealand at any age, by sex and ethnic group.

    Use for: 'life expectancy nz', 'nz life expectancy', 'life expectancy new
    zealand', 'life expectancy at 65 nz', 'how long will I live nz', 'maori life
    expectancy'.

    Stats NZ 2022-2024: at birth 80.1 years for males and 83.5 for females. At 65,
    19.4 more years for men and 21.6 for women. Maori 73.7 and 78.0 at birth,
    Pacific 74.9 and 78.9, Asian 85.0 and 87.6. A period measure on today's death
    rates; actual lives are usually longer.

    Args:
        age: Age now, 0 to 120.
        sex: male or female.
        ethnic_group: all, maori, non_maori, pacific, asian or european.

    Returns:
        Further years, the 95% interval, expected age at death, and the chance
        of reaching each later age.
name: nz_life_expectancy_calculator
